BLOCKER FOUND AND FIXED PRE-FREEZE: the aggregate reconstruction compared a 30-entry event aggregate against the raw 48-row list in both the test and check_c1 - deterministic failure; fixed by aggregating both sides per (category, target). MAJOR FIXED PRE-FREEZE: the C3 1e-2 agreement band was mechanically unmeetable (recorded T-B parity 1.01e-14 bitwise-false; recorded 7.7 percent shift from a single external reassociation); re-cut to hard bounds 1e-12 <= residual <= 1e-10 with a 5e-1 same-noise-class band. Minors: BLAS pins added to the script; historical D-047/W5 scripts recorded as non-rerunnable against the new bytes (hash-pinned records stand); static invariants test assessed low-risk at GL8 including the CP margin.
